entries.german:
Ulrich Wosner, Pfarrer von Friedberg, vermacht seine beweglichen und unbeweglichen Güter dem Stift Schlägl und stiftet mit zehn Pfund Wiener Pfennigen im Kloster einen Jahresgottesdienst am Fest der hl. Katharina mit einer Pitanz für die Brüder.

"Ego, Vlricus dictus Wosnerius(1), humilis rector ecclesie in Fridburch(2), omnibus presencia inspecturis, cupio fore notum, quod considerans luminosam ac laudabilem conuersacionem dominorum meorum in Plaga(3) sancte Marie, volens michi facere remedium singulare, ipsis et ecclesie eorum post mortem meam, eciam si forte, quod absit, intestatus decessero, lego et dono exnunc omnia bona mea, que in Fridburgensi ecclesia conquisiero seu illic de propriis apportauero, ita ut me decedente non solum vniuersa bona tam mobilia quam inmobilia, in ipsa dote inventa, verum eciam per totam parrochiam nec non circumquaque infra nemus tam in debitis quam in repositis quecumque fuerint indagata, ad ipsos ac ipsorum ecclesiam libere et sine infestacione omnium amicorum meorum sev aliorum quorumlibet deuoluantur, sub condicione et forma inferius annotata, videlicet ut me tradito debite et honorifice vbicumque elegero ecclesiastice sepulture, et quibuslibet meis debitis persolutis per ipsos aut successores eorum in mediate pro reuerencia festiuitatis mee gloriose videlicet Katherine(4) virginis, in summa decem librarum Wyennensium, certum predium comparetur: de cuius prouentibus in nocte(5) et in mane eiusdem festi fiat ibidem fratribus sev conuentui tantummodo solacium et pietancia(6) in communi: qui et festum huiusmodi cum propria hystoria et processione(7) sollempni perpetuis temporibus celebrabunt. Insuper libros ad diuinum cultum spectantes necessarios Fridburgensi ecclesie infra meos repertos, ipsi sine alienacione qualibet ibidem tenentur relinquere: reliquos ipsis in solacium, michique in memoriale perpetuum ad prelibatam Plagensem ecclesiam deportabunt(8). Ammodo in ipsorum consciencias me et mea fiducialius recommittens, vt de residuis rebus inuentis faciant et ordinent secundum quod saluti mee anime crediderint expedire. Jn cuius rei testimonium presens instrumentum ipsis dedi, sigilli domini de Rosenberch(9) nec non proprij robore conmunitum. Datum anno Domini Mo. CCCo. quinto, jn natiuitate virginis gloriose. Preterea adicio eciam et promitto, quod ecclesia in Fridburch in diuino cultu et officio non debet negligi temporibus uite mee, sed pocius debeo et promitto plenius prouidere, presencium testimonio litterarum."

Siegel: Siegel an Pergamentbändchen hängend: Pfarrer Ulrich Wosner. Gelbes Wachs, oval, 40 x 28 mm. Umschrift: "S VLRICI PLEBANI D FRIDBURCH." Wappen: Nach rechts schreitender Mann, mit Stab über der Schulter, daran die abgezogene Haut wie eine Fahne (hl. Kirchenpatron Bartholomäus).
entries.english: Ulrich Wosner, parish priest of Friedberg, bequeaths his movable and immovable goods to Schlägl Monastery and endows there, with ten pounds of Viennese pennies, an annual service on the feast of Saint Catherine, with a pitance for the brothers. He gives the monastery all goods acquired at Friedberg after his death, after his debts and burial have been provided for; the brothers are to celebrate the feast with its own office and procession forever. Books needed for divine worship are to remain at Friedberg, while the others are to be taken to the monastery as a memorial. The charter is sealed with the seal of the lord von Rosenberg and Ulrich's own seal.
